title: Return of Unopened Wound Care Dressings
content:
# Return of unopened dressings — Wound Care Supply Program

Terms on which Larkfield accepts the return of dressings shipped on the Wound Care Supply Program.

## Terms of return

1. **Unopened only.** Larkfield accepts a return only of items that are unopened and in their original sealed packaging; opened medical supplies are never returned to stock or credited on any tier where opened supplies are not returnable, because a supply that has left Larkfield's control cannot be re-dispensed to another patient. A box of dressings whose seal is broken is opened, and sterile dressings from an opened box are not returnable even when their pouches are intact.
2. **Return window.** A return is authorized only when the customer asks for it no later than the return window, in calendar days, after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that shipment, counted in calendar days from that delivery date with the last day allowed; a shipment without a proof of delivery cannot be returned, and a package damaged in transit is handled as a replacement, not a return.
3. **Units.** The units authorized for return never exceed the units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return.
4. **Receipt.** When the warehouse accepts the returned units as unopened and sealed, the units are credited back to the authorization they were drawn from; a payer-billed shipment is then re-billed by a void claim (all units returned) or a corrected claim (some units returned), and a self-pay shipment is credited to the customer's balance at the price paid for the returned units less the restocking fee percent. Returned units the warehouse finds opened are not accepted and no receipt is recorded.

When the return is authorized, the unopened condition rests on what the customer states; at receipt, it rests on what the warehouse finds.

## Window boundary (hypothetical figures)

Delivery date 2026-05-04, return window of 30 days: a request made on 2026-06-03 is within the window; a request made on 2026-06-04 is not.

## Units still returnable (hypothetical figures)

A shipment of 40 units of which 15 are already authorized for return can have at most 25 more units authorized for return.

## Effect of an accepted return

| How the shipment was billed | Units returned | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Payer claim | all units | units credited back to the authorization; void claim |
| Payer claim | some units | units credited back to the authorization; corrected claim |
| Self-pay | any | units credited back to the authorization; balance credited at the price paid less the restocking fee percent |

*Worked credit (hypothetical self-pay return, restocking fee of 15%).* 20 returned dressings paid at USD 5.90 each were paid USD 118.00 in all; 15% of USD 118.00 is USD 17.70; the credit to the balance is USD 118.00 less USD 17.70, that is USD 100.30.
